The main takeaway from our work is that
fosaprepitant can safely be added to a 5-HT3-receptor antagonist for highly emetogenic pediatric autoHSCT conditioning chemotherapy.
fosaprepitant can be safely and effectively used in children receiving high-dose chemotherapy prior to autologus hematopoietic cell transplantation.
